sloka: वृत्त दम्ष्ट्रः महा इष्वासः क्व असौ लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।यदि जीवामि साध्व् एनम् पश्येयम् सह सीतया ॥२-५९-२४॥
transliteration: vṛtta damṣṭraḥ mahā iṣvāsaḥ kva asau lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।yadi jīvāmi sādhv enam paśyeyam saha sītayā ॥2-59-24॥

translations.english: Surely it is destiny and this calamity has befallen for the wilful destruction of the (entire) race, O charioteer
